blocks.text: AI can help with an essay or a report – but in a fair way. The goal is for YOU to learn to write.
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.

items: Helping you come up with ideas and a plan.
Explaining a topic you don't understand.
Reading your text and saying what could be better.
Correcting your spelling and explaining the mistakes.
Letting the AI write the whole essay and handing it in as yours.
Copying the AI's sentences without understanding them.
Saying you didn't use AI when you did.

blocks.text: Ask your teacher what's allowed. If you use AI, be honest and say how you used it.
I'm writing an essay called "My best day ever". Don't write it for me! Ask me 5 questions to help me remember the details, then suggest a plan: introduction, middle, ending.
Here is my essay: [paste text]. Don't rewrite all of it. Tell me 3 things that are good and 3 things I could improve, and explain why.
